prompt: Write a roughly 8,000–10,000 word story based on this setup: you’re a small-time hustler who takes your boss’s wife out for a night on the town, only to have her mistake your heroin for coke and start overdosing. Flesh out the narrator, the boss’s wife, and the street dealer, and show how their backstories and motivations collide. Set the action in a gritty, neon-lit cityscape, build tension as you rush to save her with adrenaline, and explore themes of trust, desperation, and survival. Make sure to include vivid sensory details and a moral twist that leaves readers questioning who’s really in control.
